en: 1 Corinthians 12

p.src: 1  Now concerning spiritual things, brothers, I don’t want you to be ignorant.

en: Now concerning spiritual things, brothers, I don’t want you to be ignorant.
u.src: 1  Now concerning spiritual things, brothers, I don’t want you to be ignorant.

p.src: 2  You know that when you were heathen, you were led away to those mute idols, however you might be led.

en: You know that when you were heathen, you were led away to those mute idols, however you might be led.
u.src: 2  You know that when you were heathen, you were led away to those mute idols, however you might be led.

en: 12:2 or Gentiles

p.src: 3  Therefore I make known to you that no man speaking by God’s Spirit says, “Jesus is accursed.” No one can say, “Jesus is Lord,” but by the Holy Spirit.

en: Therefore I make known to you that no man speaking by God’s Spirit says, “Jesus is accursed.” No one can say, “Jesus is Lord,” but by the Holy Spirit.
u.src: 3  Therefore I make known to you that no man speaking by God’s Spirit says, “Jesus is accursed.” No one can say, “Jesus is Lord,” but by the Holy Spirit.

p.src: 4  Now there are various kinds of gifts, but the same Spirit.

en: Now there are various kinds of gifts, but the same Spirit.
u.src: 4  Now there are various kinds of gifts, but the same Spirit.

p.src: 5  There are various kinds of service, and the same Lord.

en: There are various kinds of service, and the same Lord.
u.src: 5  There are various kinds of service, and the same Lord.

p.src: 6  There are various kinds of workings, but the same God who works all things in all.

en: There are various kinds of workings, but the same God who works all things in all.
u.src: 6  There are various kinds of workings, but the same God who works all things in all.

p.src: 7  But to each one is given the manifestation of the Spirit for the profit of all.

en: But to each one is given the manifestation of the Spirit for the profit of all.
u.src: 7  But to each one is given the manifestation of the Spirit for the profit of all.

p.src: 8  For to one is given through the Spirit the word of wisdom, and to another the word of knowledge according to the same Spirit,

en: For to one is given through the Spirit the word of wisdom, and to another the word of knowledge according to the same Spirit,
u.src: 8  For to one is given through the Spirit the word of wisdom, and to another the word of knowledge according to the same Spirit,

p.src: 9  to another faith by the same Spirit, and to another gifts of healings by the same Spirit,

en: to another faith by the same Spirit, and to another gifts of healings by the same Spirit,
u.src: 9  to another faith by the same Spirit, and to another gifts of healings by the same Spirit,

p.src: 10  and to another workings of miracles, and to another prophecy, and to another discerning of spirits, to another different kinds of languages, and to another the interpretation of languages.

en: and to another workings of miracles, and to another prophecy, and to another discerning of spirits, to another different kinds of languages, and to another the interpretation of languages.
u.src: 10  and to another workings of miracles, and to another prophecy, and to another discerning of spirits, to another different kinds of languages, and to another the interpretation of languages.

p.src: 11  But the one and the same Spirit produces all of these, distributing to each one separately as he desires.

en: But the one and the same Spirit produces all of these, distributing to each one separately as he desires.
u.src: 11  But the one and the same Spirit produces all of these, distributing to each one separately as he desires.

p.src: 12  For as the body is one and has many members, and all the members of the body, being many, are one body; so also is Christ.

en: For as the body is one and has many members, and all the members of the body, being many, are one body; so also is Christ.
u.src: 12  For as the body is one and has many members, and all the members of the body, being many, are one body; so also is Christ.

p.src: 13  For in one Spirit we were all baptized into one body, whether Jews or Greeks, whether bond or free; and were all given to drink into one Spirit.

en: For in one Spirit we were all baptized into one body, whether Jews or Greeks, whether bond or free; and were all given to drink into one Spirit.
u.src: 13  For in one Spirit we were all baptized into one body, whether Jews or Greeks, whether bond or free; and were all given to drink into one Spirit.

p.src: 14  For the body is not one member, but many.

en: For the body is not one member, but many.
u.src: 14  For the body is not one member, but many.

p.src: 15  If the foot would say, “Because I’m not the hand, I’m not part of the body,” it is not therefore not part of the body.

en: If the foot would say, “Because I’m not the hand, I’m not part of the body,” it is not therefore not part of the body.
u.src: 15  If the foot would say, “Because I’m not the hand, I’m not part of the body,” it is not therefore not part of the body.

p.src: 16  If the ear would say, “Because I’m not the eye, I’m not part of the body,” it’s not therefore not part of the body.

en: If the ear would say, “Because I’m not the eye, I’m not part of the body,” it’s not therefore not part of the body.
u.src: 16  If the ear would say, “Because I’m not the eye, I’m not part of the body,” it’s not therefore not part of the body.

p.src: 17  If the whole body were an eye, where would the hearing be? If the whole were hearing, where would the smelling be?

en: If the whole body were an eye, where would the hearing be? If the whole were hearing, where would the smelling be?
u.src: 17  If the whole body were an eye, where would the hearing be? If the whole were hearing, where would the smelling be?

p.src: 18  But now God has set the members, each one of them, in the body, just as he desired.

en: But now God has set the members, each one of them, in the body, just as he desired.
u.src: 18  But now God has set the members, each one of them, in the body, just as he desired.

p.src: 19  If they were all one member, where would the body be?

en: If they were all one member, where would the body be?
u.src: 19  If they were all one member, where would the body be?

p.src: 20  But now they are many members, but one body.

en: But now they are many members, but one body.
u.src: 20  But now they are many members, but one body.

p.src: 21  The eye can’t tell the hand, “I have no need for you,” or again the head to the feet, “I have no need for you.”

en: The eye can’t tell the hand, “I have no need for you,” or again the head to the feet, “I have no need for you.”
u.src: 21  The eye can’t tell the hand, “I have no need for you,” or again the head to the feet, “I have no need for you.”

p.src: 22  No, much rather, those members of the body which seem to be weaker are necessary.

en: No, much rather, those members of the body which seem to be weaker are necessary.
u.src: 22  No, much rather, those members of the body which seem to be weaker are necessary.

p.src: 23  Those parts of the body which we think to be less honorable, on those we bestow more abundant honor; and our unpresentable parts have more abundant modesty,

en: Those parts of the body which we think to be less honorable, on those we bestow more abundant honor; and our unpresentable parts have more abundant modesty,
u.src: 23  Those parts of the body which we think to be less honorable, on those we bestow more abundant honor; and our unpresentable parts have more abundant modesty,

p.src: 24  while our presentable parts have no such need. But God composed the body together, giving more abundant honor to the inferior part,

en: while our presentable parts have no such need. But God composed the body together, giving more abundant honor to the inferior part,
u.src: 24  while our presentable parts have no such need. But God composed the body together, giving more abundant honor to the inferior part,

p.src: 25  that there should be no division in the body, but that the members should have the same care for one another.

en: that there should be no division in the body, but that the members should have the same care for one another.
u.src: 25  that there should be no division in the body, but that the members should have the same care for one another.

p.src: 26  When one member suffers, all the members suffer with it. When one member is honored, all the members rejoice with it.

en: When one member suffers, all the members suffer with it. When one member is honored, all the members rejoice with it.
u.src: 26  When one member suffers, all the members suffer with it. When one member is honored, all the members rejoice with it.

p.src: 27  Now you are the body of Christ, and members individually.

en: Now you are the body of Christ, and members individually.
u.src: 27  Now you are the body of Christ, and members individually.

p.src: 28  God has set some in the assembly: first apostles, second prophets, third teachers, then miracle workers, then gifts of healings, helps, governments, and various kinds of languages.

en: God has set some in the assembly: first apostles, second prophets, third teachers, then miracle workers, then gifts of healings, helps, governments, and various kinds of languages.
u.src: 28  God has set some in the assembly: first apostles, second prophets, third teachers, then miracle workers, then gifts of healings, helps, governments, and various kinds of languages.

p.src: 29  Are all apostles? Are all prophets? Are all teachers? Are all miracle workers?

en: Are all apostles? Are all prophets? Are all teachers? Are all miracle workers?
u.src: 29  Are all apostles? Are all prophets? Are all teachers? Are all miracle workers?

p.src: 30  Do all have gifts of healings? Do all speak with various languages? Do all interpret?

en: Do all have gifts of healings? Do all speak with various languages? Do all interpret?
u.src: 30  Do all have gifts of healings? Do all speak with various languages? Do all interpret?

p.src: 31  But earnestly desire the best gifts. Moreover, I show a most excellent way to you.

en: But earnestly desire the best gifts. Moreover, I show a most excellent way to you.
u.src: 31  But earnestly desire the best gifts. Moreover, I show a most excellent way to you.
